content.what_it_is: Fortran 77 bathymetry generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD inlet_shoal simple case with a U-channel and breakwater. On a 1024x512 grid (parameter L1) with dx=dy=2.0 (L9-L10) it builds centered coordinates shifted by y_shift=250 (L18-L23). An elliptic shoal is defined in polar form: for each point r=sqrt(x^2+y^2) and phi=atan2(y,x) (L45-L46), inner/outer ellipse radii r_in and r_out are computed from semiaxes a_in=150/b_in=80 and a_out=200/b_out=150 (L47-L54), and h=shoal_sitting-height*sin(pi/rate*dis) between them (L56-L58), reset to shoal_sitting=10 outside the annulus or for y>0 (L60-L61). Depth field: flat=10 base (L74), a plane beach for y>-width_surf via dep=flat-flat*(y+width_surf)/width_surf (L76-L78), a cosine-shaped inlet channel of half-width ramp_channel=150 keeping dep>=dep_inlet*cos(pi/(2*ramp_channel)*x) (L80-L83), and a constant basin dep_basin=5 for y>=rlength_inlet (L85-L87). Shoal and depth are combined by dep=min(dep,h) (L95-L99). A breakwater is marked as obstacle cells iobs=0 for i=412..612, j=300..301 (L111-L116) and a second depth field dep_brk carves a conical mound of radius breakwater_width=30 around each breakwater cell using d=depmax-depmax*(breakwater_width-r)/breakwater_width (L118-L130). Writes six ASCII files: x, y, dep, dep_brk, iobs, breakwater (L133-L168) with formats 3000f12.3 (L171) and 3000I3 (L172).
entities: real arrays x, y, cori, dep, dep_swan L2
real arrays h, breakwater, dep_brk L3
ii, jj breakwater loop indices L120-L121

equations.ref: outer ellipse radius, continuation L48-L49, sqrt at L50
inner ellipse radius, continuation L52-L53, sqrt at L54

unresolved: declared arrays cori and dep_swan (L2) are never assigned or written

constants depmin (L7), slope (L8), breakwater_length (L13), y_break (L14), x_break (L15), width_inlet (L26) are defined but never used; the breakwater extent is instead hard-coded as index ranges i=412,612 and j=300,301 (L111-L112, L120-L121)
hard-coded breakwater index span i=412..612 covers 200 cells = 400 m at dx=2, numerically matching the unused breakwater_length=400.0 (L13), but the file does not state this relation
format 3000f12.3 (L171) allows up to 3000 values per record while only n=512 (rows write j=1,n) are written; commented-out tmp.txt block at L65-L69 wrote h with i=1,m=1024 per record
